title: krn slice run drives one slice end to end with a resumable journal
body:
Outcome: `krn slice run <task-id> --brief <file>` drives one slice end to end by spawning the existing `bin/krn` commands per stage (claim, worktree + pnpm install, brief check, worker start/send/stop, implementation and close commits, verify, push + draft PR, lens + review, deliver) and records a resumable journal under `.krn/runs/slice/<task>/journal.json` (task, branch, worktree, base sha, brief, PR, stage, review record and attempt ordinal). A rerun resumes at the recorded stage; it stops with a stage exit code and a one-line cause on worker exit 3/4, review FAIL, or any deliver stop, and never starts a review attempt beyond the D10 budget.
Evidence: operator 2026-11-04 usefulness mandate (grant.md "Usefulness mandate"); per-PR ceremony costs tens of minutes of manual lead steps (#199-#202). Recon: .krn/runs/lead/slice-run-recon/recon.md (one PR, new src/slice/{cli,run,journal,stages}.ts, journal modelled on src/deliver/delivery.ts state).
Proof: fixture run with stubbed stage commands reaches deliver and writes the journal; a rerun after a simulated review FAIL resumes without a new claim or worktree and refuses a third review attempt.
